text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Ines Fujin,
who hasn't been in the best shape lately.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Actually, I used to work a part-time job as a shrine maiden here. Well, technically speaking, it's called "assisting service" rather than a part-time job, though.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
First we had training, where they taught us
traditional etiquette like bowing and how to walk.
And they also taught us about Shinto—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Using the etiquette I learned back then, I'm going to have the gods listen to my troubles today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
God, thank you as always.
Please continue to watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that I've made my wish,
all that's left is to do everything I can myself.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Worshiper
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, do you have a moment?
I'd like to ask about the deity
enshrined at this shrine—

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, today is actually my first time here,
so I don't really know much about it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I know the answer,
so I'll answer for you!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Worshiper
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely.
Thank you very much for your kind explanation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right back at you, thank you so much for listening to all my stories!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was able to help out at the shrine.
I'm glad I studied properly when
I worked as an assistant shrine maiden♪

After that, the blessing worked its magic,
and Ines Fujin got back in top form!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah! I heard about it when I worked as an assistant shrine maiden! The god here is, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Um... H-Huh? I can't quite recall off the top of my head... Ugh, the gods are gonna be so mad at me...!

Ines Fujin got discouraged,
and remained in a slump afterwards.
